security_finding_links.SEC-f19bdd00: Go 1.26.6 closes the eight reachable standard-library advisories reported against Go 1.26.5, and golang.org/x/text v0.39.0 closed the earlier module advisory; make vuln must report zero called vulnerabilities.
security_finding_links.SEC-de4eb072: google.golang.org/grpc v1.82.1 closes reachable GO-2026-6061 transport and authorization paths; the whole-module vulnerability advisory and served gRPC transport tests verify the repair.
security_finding_links.SEC-5b43d4b3: react-router-dom 7.18.1 is the latest published compatible release, but no published release closes every current router advisory; the exception remains needs_human.
security_finding_links.S-7268c77e: The compatible build-chain repairs are Vite 8.1.5, Vitest and coverage-v8 4.1.10, and PostCSS 8.5.23; remaining high advisories require unpublished or peer-incompatible releases and remain needs_human.

freshness_slos.scope: Direct Go dependencies that carry the control-plane spine, embedded datastore, policy engine, plugin runtime, SQL driver, or RPC transport.
React, routing, Vite, Tailwind, TypeScript, Vitest, and browser-console runtime dependencies.
Linters, formatters, coverage tooling, type packages, and local developer support packages.
GitHub Actions, Docker bases, SBOM, SCA, image signing, and release packaging dependencies.

tracked_upgrades.name: github.com/fergusstrange/embedded-postgres
tracked_upgrades.rationale: AUD-15 dated deferral. The security-maintained source fork is compiled from third_party/embedded-postgres and affects local integration tests and single-node eval startup only. The upgrade must rebase the reviewed fork, refresh committed archive pins, and refresh Trivy receipts together, so it is one reviewed change and not a source-version-only bump.

tracked_upgrades.name: github.com/nats-io/nats-server/v2
tracked_upgrades.rationale: AUD-15 dated deferral for the remaining v2.14 upgrade. QA moved the embedded server to the maintained v2.12.15 patch after the race detector proved that v2.11 read a stream name without the configuration lock during concurrent stream listing and reconfiguration. Embedded JetStream is the AN-2 event source of truth, so the later v2.14 landing still has to run replay, projection, chaos, outbox recovery, and storage-compatibility tests together.

tracked_upgrades.name: github.com/open-policy-agent/opa
tracked_upgrades.rationale: AUD-15 dated deferral, the longest of the four because the gap is the largest: v1.4.0 against v1.18.2 is fourteen minors. OPA evaluates tenant policy in-process, so the upgrade must keep Rego behaviour, the policy property tests, and the not-reachable advisory documentation aligned. Deliberately not bundled with the others: a fourteen-minor jump that fails is not diagnosable inside a combined dependency change.

tracked_upgrades.name: github.com/tetratelabs/wazero
tracked_upgrades.rationale: AUD-15 dated deferral. A WASM sandbox upgrade can change capability and host-call behaviour, which is the security boundary third-party connectors run inside; it needs pluginhost conformance and sandbox regression tests in the same change. govulncheck reports zero called vulnerabilities on the current pin, so this is hygiene debt and not live exposure.

tracked_upgrades.name: github.com/jackc/pgx/v5
tracked_upgrades.rationale: AUD-15: upgraded v5.9.2 -> v5.10.0, one minor and the cheapest row in the critical-go-runtime queue. pgx sits under every RLS-enforced PostgreSQL path, so the acceptance gate was the full internal/store suite including the RLS force inventory and the doctor ISO-1..ISO-7 isolation probes.

tracked_upgrades.name: google.golang.org/grpc
tracked_upgrades.rationale: SEC-de4eb072 upgrades the agent, SPIFFE, and signer RPC transport to the fixed GO-2026-6061 release; UDS, mTLS, workload, process-boundary, editions, and whole-module vulnerability gates pass.

tracked_upgrades.name: react
tracked_upgrades.rationale: React 19 needs a console compatibility pass across routing, auth context, accessibility tests, and the embedded Vite bundle; it is tracked as planned work rather than Dependabot churn.

tracked_upgrades.name: react-dom
tracked_upgrades.rationale: React DOM moves with React; the acceptance gate is the full console test, coverage, build, and embedded-bundle drift check.

tracked_upgrades.name: react-router-dom
tracked_upgrades.rationale: SEC-5b43d4b3: upgraded to the latest published compatible release and kept all route tests green, but that release has a newer advisory and the named fully patched release is not published; do not suppress npm audit. AUD-15 moved next_review_by from 2026-08-26 to 2026-08-20: the 60-day web-runtime budget expires that day, and a review booked after it would have let this row go red with nobody scheduled to look.

tracked_upgrades.name: vite
tracked_upgrades.rationale: S-7268c77e: upgraded the release build tool to the current patched Vite release; generated API checks, bundle hashing, Docker build, and Go embed tests pass.

tracked_upgrades.name: vitest
tracked_upgrades.rationale: S-7268c77e: upgraded Vitest with coverage-v8 to the current patched release; the full 696-test run and unchanged coverage floors pass under the supported worker model.

tracked_upgrades.name: @vitest/coverage-v8
tracked_upgrades.rationale: S-7268c77e: moved coverage-v8 with Vitest and proved the formerly vacuous exclusion pattern now measures production code while preserving all configured floors.

tracked_upgrades.name: tailwindcss
tracked_upgrades.rationale: Tailwind v4 changes CSS generation and plugin behavior; upgrade must preserve the shadcn-style console shell and visual regression gates.

tracked_upgrades.name: typescript
tracked_upgrades.rationale: TypeScript 5.9.3 is two majors behind the published 7.0.2, with 6.0.3 as the intermediate stable release; this dated deferral is the only thing holding the row inside the 1-major gap cap. The pin is deliberate, not drift: web/ runs `npm run gen:api -- --check` and `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json` before Vite builds, so a 5 -> 6 -> 7 walk has to regenerate the OpenAPI types and keep the strict build, typecheck and lint gates green in one reviewed change rather than an isolated manifest bump. This row measures web/package-lock.json only; clients/sdk/typescript pins its own typescript 5.5.4 under a separate lockfile and is not covered here.
